inlines.v: SCIAG'RAPHY, noun [Gr. a shadow, and to describe.] 1. The art of sketching or delineating. 2. In architecture, the profile or section of a building to exhibit its interior structure. 3. In astronomy, the art of finding the hour of the day or night by the shadows of objects, caused by the sun, moon or stars; the art of dialing.
